items.title: Actual noncompact conditional scores in original closed gradient

source.anchor: PBPS arXiv2609.06905v1 Section2.2 and AppendixC.1 density/closedness at1200 and actual noncompact directional score tests1217-1226; authored original-gradient graph-domain/kernel analytic prerequisites. SPHMC2609.06906v1 Section4.1 RGO covariance background is a separate consumer.
source.attribution: Samplinglib authored same-original graph-domain/kernel prerequisite for actual PBPS noncompact parameter-y scores; not a quoted numbered theorem or full Poincare/main result.

items.statement: Construct true common conditional J/R/S, positive reflected C2 potential and SAME original D_y before ALL c/u/a. Produce actual constant domain, full kernel equality and actual noncompact unnormalized directional-y score C1/gradient bound with true scalar/vector L2 class pair in SAME D_y.closure.graph. No R2/R identity or alternate operator is assumed.
assumptions: Full finite real Hilbert/Borel E including0; source V C2 and NNReal0<alpha<=beta with true all-point/all-vector alphaI<=HessV<=betaI, eta>0 and beta*eta<=1.

Actual common Gaussian J=(x,x+sqrteta*xi)#(mu*standardGaussian), Markov/disintegrating R and reflected S_y=(2x-y)#R_y; actual W_y(z)=V((y+z)/2)+norm(z-y)^2/(8eta), S_y=volume.tilted(-W_y), integrable/positive partition. SAME dense closable exact original D_y precedes ALL constants/domain elements/directions.

Actual unnormalized parameter-y score s_y(u)[a]=-DV((y+u)/2)[a]/2-inner(y-u,a)/(4eta), not the negative u-gradient or already centered normalized score. Its C1/scalarL2/boundedgradient is produced by the accepted score theorem; only literal S2_y=S_y from exact density is used.

Actual PBPS common Gaussian J/R/S/Sdensity/positive partitions/sourceC2 alpha beta eta cap and original D_y beforeALL constants/u/directions; real unnormalized y-score C1/L2/boundedgradient from accepted score producer transfers along ONLY explicit reflected density equality S2_y=S_y and enters SAME original closed graph.
